title: What Is Chainlink? How Smart Contracts See the Real World
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. A smart contract cannot look up a price by itself. Chainlink is a network of independent computers, called oracles, that bring outside data onto a blockchain, and its LINK token is used to pay them (The Block, Decrypt, Kraken). AI-generated voice. Would you trust one data source? Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: WHAT IS CHAINLINK
scenes.hook: SMART CONTRACTS ARE BLIND TO THE REAL WORLD
scenes.narration: Smart contracts are blind to the real world. So how do they get a price?

scenes.head: THE PROBLEM
scenes.hook: A BLOCKCHAIN CANNOT LOOK UP DATA ALONE
scenes.narration: A blockchain cannot check a price or the weather on its own. It needs a messenger, called an oracle.

scenes.head: THE IDEA
scenes.hook: CHAINLINK USES MANY ORACLES, NOT ONE
scenes.narration: Chainlink is a network of independent computers that report the same data. The result is checked together. The L I N K token pays them.

scenes.head: THE LIMIT
scenes.hook: BAD DATA IN MEANS BAD RESULTS OUT
scenes.narration: The catch: if the data is wrong, the contract still acts on it. An oracle is one more thing to trust.
